articles.title: Navigating MTZ Disputes in the Global Automotive Supply Chain: A Comparative Legal Analysis of PRC and German Law
articles.excerpt: As the global automotive industry grapples with squeezed margins, geopolitical shifts, and the costly transition to electric vehicles, the traditional Material Price Surcharge (MTZ) has transformed from a routine commercial adjustment tool into a critical legal battleground.

articles.excerpt: Because "revoked but not deregistered" is not a clean exit. It can become a due diligence issue, a tax issue, a litigation issue, and in some cases a personal risk issue for the legal representative, directors, senior officers, or liquidation obligors.
